notes: Actions are kglobalaccel action names in the 'kwin' component. Their key chords are read from the user's kglobalshortcutsrc (read-only) unless --binding overrides them.
condition 'none': Plastile is not loaded (no tiling script). condition 'plastile': Plastile is loaded.
expect 'resize': each sample must change the size of at least one fixture window. expect 'activate': each sample must change which fixture is activated.

P02-quicktile alternates Quick Tile Top and Bottom on a window first tiled Left: Left -> TopLeft -> Left (observed source: kwin v6.7.5 src/window.cpp combineQuickTileMode, handleQuickTileShortcut). It never repeats a mode, so it never moves the window to another output.
matchedBaseline names the 'none' workload used for the PERFORMANCE section 4 verdict; every other baseline at the same output and window count is reported as a control comparison only.

controlBaselines names further workloads (of either condition) compared as controls only; they never change the verdict. P00-switch-tiled is KWin's own switch on Plastile's tiles: the activation configure waits for the decoration's re-render, which grows with window area (PERFORMANCE section 5.1), and P00-switch runs on KWin's smaller placement.

P00-maximize.description: No tiler: KWin's own Maximize Window toggle on the active fixture (maximize, restore, ...)

P02-quicktile.description: Native quick tile without a tiler: tile Left once (setup), then alternate Quick Tile Top and Quick Tile Bottom

P00-switch.description: No tiler: KWin's Switch to Window to the Right (directional focus); needs windows that do not share a centre

P03-ratio.description: Plastile master/stack ratio: alternate Grow and Shrink focused tile (every window in the context resizes)

P03-swap.description: Plastile Swap with master, repeated (the two windows exchange slots of different sizes)

P03-focus.description: Plastile Focus next (activation only; zero geometry writes by design)

P00-switch-tiled.description: KWin's Switch to Window to the Right with Plastile loaded: KWin's own activation on Plastile's tile geometry (control for P03-focus at tile-sized windows; KWin's switch wraps around, kwin v6.7.5 src/useractions.cpp switchWindow, so it alternates the master and a stack tile while focus.next cycles every tile)
